backup_dir.description: Top-level data directory where backup storage, logs, and configs are kept.

install_dir.description: Installation directory (contains binaries, templates, and scripts).

rsyncd_password.description: Password for rsyncd authentication (empty for SSH-only mode).

rsyncd_user.description: User account used for rsyncd connections.

rsync_client_extra_args.description: Extra arguments passed to client-side rsync during backups (e.g., --bwlimit=5000).

rsync_client_restore_extra_args.description: Extra arguments passed to client-side rsync during restores.

log_dir.description: Directory for BackupPC log files (log, log.old, etc.).

cgi_url.description: Public URL for the BackupPC web interface.

cgi_bin_dir.description: Directory containing the BackupPC CGI scripts.

cgi_image_dir.description: Directory containing images and icons for the web interface.

cgi_temp_dir.description: Temporary directory used by the web interface for temporary files.

admin_users.description: List of usernames with full administrative access to the web interface.

items.description: Username allowed full admin access (must match web auth user).

cgi_user_admin_restrict.description: When true, non-admin users can only manage hosts they own.

compress_level.description: Compression level (0–9); higher = better compression, more CPU.

full_period.description: Interval (in days) between full backups (e.g., '6.95' = weekly).

incr_period.description: Interval (in days) between incremental backups (e.g., '0.95' = daily).

full_age_max.description: Maximum age (in days) of a full backup before it’s considered expired.

incr_age_max.description: Maximum age (in days) of an incremental backup before it’s considered expired.

max_backups.description: Maximum number of backups to keep per host (including full and incremental).

bpcp_d_period.description: Interval (in days) for BackupPCD (disk-to-disk rotation) runs.

bpcp_d_retention.description: How long BackupPCD backups are retained (in days).

ping_max_msec.description: Maximum response time (ms) for a host ping before marking it offline.

client_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for client-side operations (e.g., SSH, tar).

paranoia.description: If true, skip files that look like temporary/lock files (e.g., *.tmp, core, *.log).

global_exclude_patterns.description: List of per-share exclusion patterns for rsync.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the pattern set.

rsync_extra_args.description: List of extra arguments for rsync backup (e.g., ['--exclude=*.log']).

rsync_backup_share_name.description: Rsync share name to apply this pattern to (e.g., '/' or 'C$').

rsync_restore_extra_args.description: List of extra arguments for rsync restore.

db_backend.description: Database backend for metadata storage: 'none', 'mysql', or 'pg'.

email_smtp_host.description: SMTP server host (only used if email_transport = 'smtp').

email_smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (only used if email_transport = 'smtp').

ssh_args.description: Extra SSH args used by BackupPC to connect to clients.

ssh_client_args.description: Extra SSH args for client-side operations (e.g., tar).

lock_dir.description: Directory for lock files (prevents concurrent runs).

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files during transfers.

queue_dir.description: Directory for the backup job queue.

queue_max.description: Maximum number of queued backup jobs.

global_rsync_extra_args.description: Global extra args for rsync backup (applies to all shares unless overridden).

global_rsync_restore_extra_args.description: Global extra args for rsync restore.

archive_enabled.description: Enable archive feature (copy backups to secondary storage).

archive_client_extra_args.description: Extra client args for archive client command (SSH/rsync).

archive_client_restore_extra_args.description: Extra client args for archive restore command.

archive_paranoia.description: Apply paranoia exclusion rules to archive (like backup).
